text:
Alex P: Heads-up — planning a staggered deploy for v2.18 this Tue. Need alignment on region cutoffs, canary length, and warmup windows. Proposed windows below — pls +1 or suggest changes.

Alex P: ```
US (primary): Tue 02:00 - 04:00 PDT (canary 02:00-02:30)
EU (stagger): Tue 10:00 - 12:00 UTC (canary 10:00-10:30)
APAC (final): Tue 22:00 - 00:00 SGT (canary 22:00-22:30)
```

Li W: +1 on the general pattern. Quick q: changelog / branch freeze cutoff? do we want services freeze 48h before US window? :thinking_face:

Emma G: Recommend branch freeze 24h before the first region unless we expect DB migrations. If config-only, 12h is fine. For v2.18 there is a schema tweak in core-auth so 48h would be safer.

Jordan (eng-sre): Heads-up from SRE — APAC 22:00 SGT hits late-night oncall in some teams. Can we move APAC earlier to 20:00 SGT and shorten canary to 15m if we do an extended prewarm? Also: we should avoid overlapping heavy infra jobs (backups) at 21:30.

Sam R: From runtime: we'll need a 30m warmup slot before canary to prime KV caches and model weights. Suggest prewarm 30m before each canary start. Prewarm script (run from infra pool):

Sam R: ```bash
# warmup endpoint
for i in {1..30}; do 
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" -d '{"input":"warmup"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate >/dev/null
  sleep 1
done
```

Alex P: Good catch — adjust plan: APAC to 20:00-22:00 SGT, canary 20:00-20:15, prewarm 19:30-20:00. Update changelog/branch freeze to 48h before US window.

Li W: noted. I'll send a changelog reminder to #product and #docs at freeze cutoff.

Emma G: How long for canaries overall? propose 30m for each region with health checks at 5,15,30 mins. If any serious lat regressions, automatic rollback.

Jordan (eng-sre): Sounds good. We'll block backup jobs and DB maintenance for Tue 19:00-01:00 UTC window. Also enabling extra logging for the first 2h of each region. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary checks: 2026-03-24T02:00:00-07:00 (US) | 2026-03-24T10:00:00Z (EU) | 2026-03-24T20:00:00+08:00 (APAC).

Sam R: FYI: Runtime will auto-scale replicas +20% during canary and first hour. Cost hit should be minimal but flag for finance.

Alex P: Action items:
- Li: changelog + docs reminder at freeze (48h)
- Emma: post canary health checklist and rollback playbook
- Jordan: block infra jobs and enable extra logs
- Sam: run prewarm and confirm autoscale config

Alex P: If no objections I'll lock windows and update release calendar by EOD. :thumbsup:

Li W: +1

Emma G: +1

Jordan (eng-sre): +1

Sam R: +1

Alex P: Thanks everyone — I'll post the final schedule and the changelog ping.
